note: Incident ridebannercount20261004: the on-bus banner's stop count to the exit rose as the bus moved and fired "Get off NEXT stop!" stops early. Five rider-watcher rides, one feed row per rider sample (10 s) from ten minutes before boarding to 30 s after arrival, copied verbatim (bus_id dropped) from the recordings named in `source`; `shown` is the banner headline the page printed (null before boarding). `rideStops` is the ride's calls in travel order, pickup first: upstream's list as repaired (`repairedOrder` in green-/purple-published-order.json), and Pink's list as published, its ring's twins being one call a lap. Geometry is the three *-published-order.json fixtures, identical to production's /api/buses routes 8, 9 and 10 on 2026-10-04.
